title: One step of the borrow computation
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input, let $p$ be an allowed input-head position, and let $v$ and $s$ be finite Boolean words. If the one-tape debit machine is in its initial search state, its head is at position $|v|$, and its tape contains $v s$, then one step yields the following configuration: if $s$ is empty, it enters the borrow-result state carrying false, moves its head to $|v|-1$, and leaves the tape as $v$; if $s$ begins with true, it enters the borrow-result state carrying true, moves its head to $|v|-1$, and changes that first symbol to false; if $s$ begins with false, it remains in the initial search state, moves its head to $|v|+1$, and changes that first symbol to true.
hypotheses_covered: The tape contains the concatenation $v s$
